summary: Data East's 1982 top-down vehicular-combat driving game, originally Burnin' Rubber in Japan and known in North America as Bump 'n' Jump.

entries.title: Bump 'n' Jump
entries.definitive_edition: Original arcade release / Data East Arcade Classics for official compilation access

emulation.notes: MAME preserves the original arcade game; the Wii compilation is an official emulated access route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original arcade presentation with modern scaling

primary.version: Original Data East / Bally Midway arcade release
primary.why: Bump 'n' Jump originated as a Data East arcade game on DECO Cassette System/dedicated arcade hardware, with later home ports and compilation releases adapting that arcade version. The arcade original is the highest-fidelity and most authentic route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the arcade version in MAME/original hardware; Data East Arcade Classics on Wii is an official compilation fallback.

entries.remaster_caveats: C64 Burnin' Rubber and Bumping Buggies are sourced as C64 clones rather than core official release rows; Data East Arcade Classics is an emulated compilation, not a remaster.
